arabic_html:
أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا
خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ ۞
translation: Unquestionably, for the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve -
exp_h: Who the allies of Allah are
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: they are simply those who believe and are mindful of Allah. No fear of what is ahead of them, and no grief over what they left behind.
